revised_teaching_units.scope: Compare the Kubernetes Eviction subresource, direct deletion and Deployment rollout with the same ready Pods and strict PDB.
revised_teaching_units.observation: The API accepted an eviction while budget remained, then refused under a stricter budget. Direct deletion and controller rollout could reduce or replace replicas. Undo restored three ready replicas in a single-node kind cluster.

revised_teaching_units.scope: Observe uneven input termination, two weighting choices and the optimizer-state boundary with two actual CPU/Gloo ranks.
revised_teaching_units.observation: An unmatched operation timed out. The two join denominators produced different weights. After model broadcast, old SGD momentum still diverged until it was explicitly synchronized.
